pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Read the descriptions before choosing. This quest does not change your race or unlock powers.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Choice, successful powers and mastery belong to one race owner. Reselection follows native screen eligibility; quests neither grant a race nor require cycling through all five.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Appearance uses the native skin library; model preview neither authenticates identity nor changes ownership of money/rewards.
